sections.description: Build curated, SEO-friendly taxonomy archive pages with the WordPress block editor.
sections.changelog:
= 1.6.7 =
* Disables assigned terms when there is one area, and occupied areas for the selected term when there are multiple areas.
* Rejects duplicate taxonomy, term, and area assignments on REST saves, including drafts and autosaves.

= 1.6.6 =
* Preserve archive term and content-area selections during native WordPress draft autosaves and revision restoration.

= 1.6.5 =
* Renames the dashboard menu and related editing labels to Archive Pages to reflect support for multiple taxonomies.

= 1.6.4 =
* Display the official Made to Thrive circle badge in WordPress plugin updates.

= 1.6.3 =
* Use the handwritten mtt mark for plugin update icons; retain the existing admin menu mark.

= 1.6.2 =
* Improve the template area name field with a wider input and help text underneath.

= 1.6.1 =
* Fix the Archive Page Content editor crash by using the public block insertion selector.

= 1.6.0 =
* Add multiple named template areas and per-area term assignments.
* Hide the area choice for single-area sites.
* Support custom post type taxonomies and post-type/taxonomy list filters.

= 1.5.0 =
* Adds automatic populated child-category navigation with per-category include and exclude settings.
* Exposes the shared archive-term resolver for contextual recipe grids and server-rendered previews.
* Preserves the standard MTT update channel and existing archive editor features.


= 1.4.2 =
* Lets editors dismiss the initial term chooser with its close button or Escape key.
* Allows drafts and autosaves without a term while preventing publish, schedule, or private publication until a valid term is selected.
* Adds matching client-side guidance and server-side publish validation.

= 1.4.1 =
* Replaces the Category Pages admin menu icon with the Made to Thrive brand mark.
* Sizes the SVG on a 20-pixel square canvas while preserving its original proportions.

= 1.4.0 =
* Establishes the canonical Made to Thrive release and update channel.
* Includes the 1.3.0 short-description and term-field block binding features.
* Restores the 1.2.6 opt-in setting for showing curated content on paginated archives.
* Keeps automatic updates disabled unless the agency explicitly opts in.
* Raises the maintained release line to WordPress 6.9 and PHP 8.1.

= 1.3.0 =
* Adds a short archive description to taxonomy and Archive Page editing screens.
* Adds block bindings for archive taglines and generated recipe headings.
* Preserves category images when terms are updated through another workflow.

= 1.2.6 =
* Adds an opt-in setting for showing curated content on paginated archives.
